gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-syriac-e: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern stands tall in the lowercase, its curve endings keeping well clear of one another. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern sits under Coming Soon's casual handwriting and carries a long read with an approachable, steady ease.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke, with small letters packed dense and tall. Noto Sans Syriac Western feels crisp and modern beside Coming Soon, whose bent-paperclip strokes look scribbled by hand.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog fills the middle of each line, with generous gaps in its curves. Make Coming Soon small and its pen-drawn, single-thickness strokes lose their charm, while a large Noto Sans Tagalog simply stays a plain sans.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Coming Soon draws its handwritten letters as plain as stitched thread outlines, with lowercase rising close to the capitals. It greets the eye; Noto Sans Tagbanwa does the clear, open reading.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le lets its ink strokes taper out before they touch, with hardly any step from capital to lowercase. And Coming Soon, with tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, gives it a casual, personal handwritten voice above.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Approachable chalk-board lowercase in Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds toward the capital line, while the inside of each c stays clearly visible. Shrink Coming Soon and its brush-free handwriting gets lost beside it.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Coming Soon writes even its w with no thick or thin strokes, a casual, personal hand. But Noto Sans Tai Viet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, steps in as the plain sans that keeps everything easy to follow.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri leaves a generously open curve on every small round letter, and its lowercase sits high-waisted. Coming Soon is best at casual warmth; Noto Sans Takri is best at contemporary clarity.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified even when the size hasn't changed, its terminals stopping far from the stem. And Coming Soon, whose curves never shift in weight, makes a long stretch of it feel modern and light.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-tamil-su: Round forms in Noto Sans Tamil Supplement look like open parentheses, and the middle band is so tall the line looks stocky. Its sturdy build against Coming Soon's wirelike handwriting is the draw.
